stemMd: A right triangle has an acute angle θ with cos θ=7/25. What is sin θ?
explanationMd: The adjacent leg and hypotenuse are in the ratio 7:25. The opposite leg is proportional to the square root of 625−49=24, so sine is 24/25.

distractorRationale.b: This subtracts side lengths rather than using the Pythagorean relation.
distractorRationale.d: A sine of an acute angle cannot exceed one.
distractorRationale.a: This is not the opposite-to-hypotenuse ratio.
